RbcTcsWorld Shop: test reports

Published by GitHub Actions after every green build of main.

  • Allure reportAPI, database, BDD (Cucumber) and Selenium UI tests, with history and trends
  • Cucumber reportEvery Gherkin feature and scenario with its steps, as the business reads them
  • Playwright reportChromium, Firefox, WebKit, Pixel 7 and iPhone 14, with traces of any failure
  • Code coverage (JaCoCo)Backend lines and branches covered by unit and integration tests
  • Mutation testing (PIT)How many deliberately planted bugs the tests catch
